title: Project Stark | Free
features:
🐺 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 🐺

✦ HUSS VALLEY | PROJECT STARK ✦

🐺 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 🐺

✨ Catch like a demon. Run like the wind. 😈

┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓

┃ 👁️ V I S U A L S ┃

┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

🟩 Player ESP — boxes, names, distance, health bars, skeleton, tracers & chams, all role-colored (🟢 runners / 🔴 catchers)

🎯 Team Check — only see the OTHER side: as a runner you see catchers, as a catcher you see runners

👥 Roles Shown filter — pick exactly who gets drawn (lobby players never render)

🖼️ Box Style • Box Fill • Visible Only • Max Distance • Text Size — all adjustable

💎 Gem ESP — every gem with ✚amount & distance labels

🏃 Route To Gems — auto-walks you straight to the nearest gem

🚧 Hazard ESP — chasers & barrels spotted the moment they spawn

👻 Show Future Path — see EXACTLY where every hazard is heading (Predict Ahead slider)

┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓

┃ ⚔️ C O M B A T ┃

┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

🎯 Catch Aim — aims a perfect, legal swing at the closest runner (never fails the server's reach check)

🔪 Auto Swing + 👻 Lead The Target — swings for you, even on moving targets

📏 Aim Range slider

⚡ Auto Use Ability (+ Only When Needed) — pops your ability at the perfect moment

🛟 Auto Rescue — saves downed teammates (+ Give Up Range slider)

💨 Auto Dodge — dashes away the instant a catcher closes in (+ Dodge Range slider)

┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓

┃ 🛠️ M I S C ┃

┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

😴 Anti-AFK — never get kicked

🙈 Hide Name — go fully incognito (+ one-click re-apply on respawn)

┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓

┃ ⚙️ H U B ┃

┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛

💾 Full config system — save / load / reset your own presets, per game

🔑 Menu keybind (default RightShift) — rebind anytime in Credits

📱 Mobile support — floating toggle button

🧹 Clean unload button

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

🎮 HOW TO USE

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

1️⃣ Copy the script (loadstring)

2️⃣ Execute in Huss Valley with any supported executor?

3️⃣ Press RightShift to open the menu

🐺 ▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ 🐺
